We just had two panelists drop for Emily Choi's onsite loop next Wed 10:00am PT (candidate already confirmed). Travel + a conflicting vendor demo ate up Marcus and Sofia's availability and we need immediate replacements. The role is Senior Inference Engineer — technical loop focus: model compilation, KV cache/latency questions, quantization/FPK tradeoffs.

Quick asks:
- Can either of you suggest two available interviewers who can cover compiler/latency and quantization? Prefer senior ICs or staff engs who know model serving tradeoffs.
- If we can't find full coverage, I want to split the loop (one person on systems/latency, one on model/quant) and have a rapid 30-min debrief after. I'll own scheduling the debrief.

Potential names I thought of (feel free to veto): Mateo Alvarez (platform runtime), Marissa Cole (inference perf), Ethan Park (ops) — Ethan is likely on-call.

Emily's interview packet is attached; it's a hard date for her (rescheduled already once). If we can't fill internally, we can pull from the standby pool but prefer to keep the loop within infra/serving.

TIA — Markus

--
Markus Klein
